mapper.select: SELECT id, wkt, name, length, width, fold_summary, geom, ST_Distance( geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}::double precision, #{lat}::double precision), 4326)::geography ) AS distance, ST_Azimuth( ST_ClosestPoint(geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}::double precision, #{lat}::double precision), 4326)), ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}::double precision, #{lat}::double precision), 4326) ) AS azimuth FROM data_geological_fold WHERE geom IS NOT NULL ORDER BY geom <-> ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}::double precision, #{lat}::double precision), 4326) LIMIT 1
